explanation_guide.normalized_edit_distance: Fraction of character edits required to transform candidate SLD to trusted SLD. Lower values indicate strong typosquatting.
explanation_guide.jaro_winkler: Prefix-weighted string similarity. Higher values indicate close visual or phonetic match.
explanation_guide.brand_in_subdomain: Deceptive inclusion of trusted brand inside candidate subdomain.
explanation_guide.digit_substitution_count: Leet-speak / visual digit substitutions (0 for o, 1 for l/i, 3 for e).
explanation_guide.has_homoglyph: Usage of non-ASCII Cyrillic/Greek Unicode homoglyphs.
